title: CanonicalEventEnvelope
description: DRAFT (v0, Milestone 0 foundation). Structural envelope for a provider-neutral canonical event. The concrete event catalogue, payload schemas and privacy allowlist are owned by Milestone 1 (M1-01, M1-02) and require review by all three divisions. Deliberately has NO tenant field: tenancy is derived at authenticated admission, never trusted from the payload. The envelope is closed (additionalProperties: false) so unexpected fields, including prohibited content, are rejected rather than forwarded.

eventId.description: Stable identifier of the logical event (UUID).

eventType.description: Namespaced event type. The permitted catalogue is an M1 decision; only the syntax is fixed here.

policyVersion.description: Version of the local privacy allowlist policy applied before persistence.

attributes.description: Allowlisted metadata. v0 accepts only short scalar values keyed by identifiers. Attribute names that denote default-prohibited outbound content (consolidated brief §13) are rejected as defence in depth. This denylist is NOT the privacy boundary: the local allowlist processor (M1-02) must remove prohibited content before persistence, because prohibited content placed in an innocuous attribute value cannot be detected structurally.
